meta.title: lpdf Showcase — Footnote Counter
meta.subject: Where the numbers of the footnotes start over

column.text: The numbers start over on every page.
The first page of the section has two notesThe first note of the first page., and they are numbered from 1The second note of the first page..
The second page of the section has two notes tooThe first note of the second page., and the numbers start overThe second note of the second page: its number is 2, though the section has four notes..
The numbers go on across the sections that count so.
This section is the first to count across the documentThe first note of the document counter., so its notes are numbered from 1The second note of the document counter..
It goes on from the section before.
This section goes on from the two notes before itThe third note of the document counter., so its notes are numbered 3The fourth note of the document counter. and 4.
The numbers start over in the section, which is what a section does without a counter.
This section counts its own notesThe first note of the section., from 1The second note of the section., whatever the sections before it did.
